features.title: The Organ
features.description: The most distinctive rock formation with perfectly hexagonal basalt columns rising up to 100 feet.

features.title: The Giant's Boot
features.description: A distinctive rock formation resembling a giant boot, one of the most photographed features.

features.title: Visitor Centre
features.description: National Trust visitor centre with exhibitions on the geology and mythology of the Giant's Causeway.

features.title: The Wishing Chair
features.description: A natural rock formation with a chair-like appearance. Local legend suggests wishes made here come true.

features.title: Chimney Stacks
features.description: Vertical basalt columns that appear like industrial chimneys. Part of the cooling patterns of ancient lava flows.

features.title: Dunluce Castle Viewpoint
features.description: Ruins of a medieval castle visible from the Causeway. Historic stronghold of the MacDonnell clan.
